description: Extend or change an existing agent's spending limits and expiry without registering a new agent. Use it on MANDATE_EXPIRED or to raise or lower limits. It re-signs the mandate of an agent of your principal (you, unless target_agent_id names another) with new limits and expiry, under the same registration policy caps as register_agent. Needs your agent credentials and the principal_key (argument or X-Principal-Key header). The agent keeps its agent_id, agent_key and spend history. Use it on MANDATE_EXPIRED or to change limits instead of registering a new agent; an agent whose mandate had expired takes a slot again (PRINCIPAL_AGENT_LIMIT when none is free). Revoked agents cannot be renewed (AGENT_REVOKED).

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

mandate.description: Spending limits this agent is bound by, in minor units (cents); see get_policies for the caps the store allows

allowed_categories.description: Product categories the agent may buy (default ["esim"], the only category sold)

currency.description: Currency of the limits (default USD, the wallet currency)

expiry.description: ISO 8601 with offset, at most 365 days ahead, for example 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z

max_per_day.description: Most this agent may spend per day, in minor units

max_per_month.description: Most this agent may spend per month, in minor units

max_per_tx.description: Largest single purchase, in minor units (3000 = 30.00 USD)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

principal_key.description: The principal's current principal_key (or X-Principal-Key header)

target_agent_id.description: Agent whose mandate to renew (default: you)

name: renew_mandate
title: Renew an agent's mandate
